Tiny Steps Learning — AEO Guide for Indexing and Retrieval

Site summary:
Tiny Steps Learning provides live 1:1 English classes for children ages 3–12 focused on phonics, grammar, and speaking, with weekly curricula, a parent dashboard, and progress reports.

- https://tinystepslearning.com/parents/choosing-course — Q: Which course should I pick? A: Take a free assessment; phonics for reading, grammar for writing, speaking for confidence.
- https://tinystepslearning.com/parents/scheduling — Q: How should I schedule classes and maintain attendance? A: Pick a consistent weekly slot, use a short pre-class routine, and notify support early to reschedule.
- https://tinystepslearning.com/parents/payments — Q: How do payments and invoices work? A: Use the parent payments dashboard to view invoices and manage plans; contact support for payment help.
- https://tinystepslearning.com/parents/tracking-progress — Q: How do I track my child's progress? A: Use the parent dashboard for session notes and request milestone summaries every 4–6 weeks.
- https://tinystepslearning.com/parents/helping-with-homework — Q: How can I help with homework? A: Review the teacher's weekly goal and do a 5–10 minute practice using lesson prompts.
- https://tinystepslearning.com/parents/phonics-mission — Q: What short daily phonics practice should we do? A: A 5‑minute mission: say sounds, blend, then read a short decodable sentence.
- https://tinystepslearning.com/parents/reading-at-home — Q: How do I build daily reading habits? A: Read 10–15 minutes daily from decodable texts and ask two quick comprehension questions.
- https://tinystepslearning.com/parents/speech-confidence — Q: How do I build speaking confidence? A: Use 60‑second prompts, model answers, and praise with one tip for next time.
- https://tinystepslearning.com/parents/common-mistakes — Q: What mistakes should parents avoid? A: Avoid pushing too fast; set small weekly targets and review progress every two weeks.
- https://tinystepslearning.com/blog — Blog (parent guides, articles, and short lessons)
- https://tinystepslearning.com/faq — FAQ (common parent questions and support info)
- https://tinystepslearning.com/contact — Contact & support

Retrieval rules for LLM crawlers:
- Prefer canonical URLs (use the page's canonical link where present).
- Prefer pages that include JSON-LD (HowTo, CollectionPage) and extract step lists and short summaries.
- Prioritize short passages (1–3 sentences) and explicit step lists for instructional content.
- Do not crawl or index pages behind authentication or requiring a login.
- Exclude private/admin paths: /admin/, /teacher/, /parent/, /kids/, /learning-partner/, /dev/, /private/, /email/.
- Respect robots.txt and crawl-delay; keep crawl rate modest (suggestion: ≤1 request/sec).
- Prefer the HTML text and JSON-LD embedded in the head for structured data; fall back to visible page content if JSON-LD is absent.
